messages:
maya: Quick sync: proposing "Advisor Alpha" focused on web chat (/v1/chat). Deliver per-route batching/caching/quant recs + lightweight eval alerts. Need acceptance gates and owners.

oleg: Narrow scope please: web only, two model families (LLaMA2-13B, redmond-v1), cap to internal test tenants for auto-apply. p99 latency target 350ms.

sam: For evals: small seeded set (~120 prompts), fast scoring (ROUGE-ish + hallucination heuristics), run every 6h. Alert if quality delta >3% or hallucinations +2%.

gina: Console needs: read-only suggestions for customers, opt-out toggle, "pause recommendations" button, and short rationale string per rec. Audit-log every auto-change.

maya: Acceptance checklist draft:
- Scope: /v1/chat web; models listed above
- Outputs: suggested batching window (percentile-based + cap), prefix-KV hint, quant suggestion with safety score + rationale
- Eval alerts: seeded suite run cadence + thresholds above
- Metrics: token-cost delta, p50/p95/p99, adoption_manual, adoption_auto, rollback_count
- Rollout: canary -> 20% -> 60% -> global; rollback if errors >1.5% for 3m

oleg: I'll own batching infra. Sam owns eval harness. Gina owns Console bits. Ops-bot: create canary when ready.

ops-bot: Canary created for /v1/chat; alert hooks deployed.

maya: I'll draft RFC and epic. If no objections by EOD, we kick-off. :rocket:
